Si pour assurer la continuité de service, la solution implique de la maintenance préventive, les opérations seront planifiées afin de ne pas gêner l’activité et les utilisateurs seront avisés 48 heures avant. Le cas échéant, la maintenance intègrera sans surcoût, les évolutions mineures de l’outil, sous réserve de l’acceptation des organismes utilisateurs. La maintenance comprend la main d’œuvre et les éventuels déplacements du titulaire nécessaire au bon fonctionnement de la solution. Une solution d’assistance en cas d’évolutions des besoins des Caf : Les évolutions pourront porter sur un changement de personnel en charge du traitement et un changement de nature et de typologie des courriers. En cas de changement des personnes en charge du traitement des courriers, il est demandé que les modifications d’habilitations soient à la main de l’administrateur de la Caf (pour garantir la réactivité). En cas de changement des courriers type, il est demandé une réactivité dans la réponse à apporter par le prestataire. Un engagement de service est attendu : 3 jours max

entity_geography.text: 2_Eigenerklaerung_Bezug_Russland-0422.docx ===== Entsprechend der Verordnung (EU) 2022/576 dürfen öffentlichen Aufträge und Konzessionen nach dem 9. April 2022 nicht an Personen oder Unternehmen vergeben werden, die einen Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift aufweisen. Dies umfasst sowohl unmittelbar als Bewerber, Bieter oder Auftragnehmer auftretende Personen oder Unternehmen als auch mittelbar, mit mehr als zehn Prozent, gemessen am Auftragswert, beteiligte Unterauftragnehmer, Lieferanten oder Eignungsverleiher. Ein Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift besteht durch die russische Staatsangehörigkeit des Bewerbers/Bieters oder die Niederlassung des Bewerbers/Bieters in Russland, durch die Beteiligung einer natürlichen Person oder eines Unternehmens, auf die eines der Kriterien nach Buchstabe a zutrifft, am Bewerber/Bieter über das Halten von Anteilen im Umfang von mehr als 50 Prozent, durch das Handeln der Bewerber/Bieter im Namen oder auf Anweisung von Personen oder Unternehmen, auf die die Kriterien der Buchstaben a und/oder b zutreffen. Bereits vor dem 9. April 2022 geschlossene Verträge mit solchen Personen oder Unternehmen mit Bezug zu Russland dürfen nur bis zum 10. Oktober 2022 fortgeführt werden. EBVPD – Europos bendrasis viešųjų pirkimų dokumentas, aktuali deklaracija, pakeičianti kompetentingų institucijų išduodamus dokumentus ir preliminariai patvirtinanti, kad tiekėjas ir ūkio subjektai, kurių pajėgumais jis remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį (VPĮ 88 straipsnio 5 dalies nuostatų taikymo atvejais ir subtiekėjai), atitinka pirkimo dokumentuose pagal VPĮ 46, 47, 48 straipsnius nustatytus reikalavimus ir, jeigu taikytina, 54 straipsnyje nustatytus reikalavimus dėl kokybės vadybos sistemos ir (arba) aplinkos apsaugos vadybos sistemos standartų laikymosi, kurio forma prieinama interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Įgaliotoji organizacija – pirkimams organizuoti, pirkimo procedūroms iki sutarties ar preliminariosios sutarties sudarymo atlikti, taip pat atlikto pirkimo procedūrų ataskaitai ar skelbimui apie sudarytą sutartį ar preliminariąją sutartį pateikti perkančiosios organizacijos įgaliota organizacija, nurodyta specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose. Komisija – viešojo pirkimo komisija. Perkančioji organizacija – specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose nurodyta perkančioji organizacija. Pirkimas – perkančiosios organizacijos atliekamas viešasis pirkimas. Preliminarioji sutartis – preliminarioji viešojo pirkimo-pardavimo sutartis (jei taikoma), vienos ar k

PĮ 49 straipsnį (jeigu perkančioji organizacija nustato tiekėjo kvalifikacijos reikalavimus); pasiūlymo teikimo metu žinomi subtiekėjai (jeigu perkančioji organizacija nustato reikalavimus dėl subtiekėjų pašalinimo pagrindų). fiziniai asmenys, kuriuos tiekėjas ketina įdarbinti Pirkimo laimėjimo atveju ir kurių pajėgumais tiekėjas remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 (kvazisubtiekėjai) (jeigu perkančioji organizacija nustato reikalavimus dėl fizinių asmenų, kurių kvalifikacija tiekėjas remiasi ir kuriuos, pirkimo laimėjimo atveju, tiekėjas ketina įdarbinti, pašalinimo pagrindų). EBVPD pildomas jį įkėlus interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Tiekėjas, pildydamas EBVPD, laukelyje „Procedūros tipas“ turi pasirinkti „Atvira“. Teikdamas pasiūlymą CVP IS priemonėmis šį EBVPD tiekėjas turi pridėti kartu su kitais pasiūlymo dokumentais (pasiūlymo pateikimo skiltyje „Prisegti dokumentus“). EBVPD nurodytą informaciją pagrindžiantys dokumentai kartu su pasiūlymu neteikiami. Perkančioji organizacija bet kuriuo pirkimo procedūros metu gali paprašyti dalyvių pateikti visus ar dalį dokumentų, patvirtinančių jų pašalinimo pagrindų nebuvimą, atitiktį kvalifikacijos reikalavimams ir, jeigu taikytina, kokybės vadybos sistemos ir (arba) aplinkos apsaugos vadybos sistemos standartams, jeig

Section I: Program Overview & Background 1.1 Purpose The Department of the Air Force (DAF), Business and Enterprise Systems (BES) Directorate, AFLCMC/GBGD, is issuing this Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) to identify and acquire an innovative, commercially available Digital Adoption Platform (DAP). This platform will replace the legacy Oracle User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready so

User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready software-guided training and performance-support tool. It must streamline content creation, simplify software adoption, and provide real-time in-application guidance for the DEAMS user base. 1.2 Mission Impact & Capability Gap The current solution (Oracle UPK) represents unsupported software and significant technical debt. Its retirement creates a critical operational gap in how training is conducted across the enterprise. The replacement DAP will modernize training material outputs, provide interactive in-application assistance, and reduce the overall training footprint. This capability is designated as a Criticality (1) — Must Have requirement to support continuous financial and enterprise operations. 1.3 Scope of the Target Environment • User Base: Approximately 26,000+ geographically dispersed personnel across 170+ global locations. • Primary Integration: Stable and proven integration with Oracle e-Business Suite (EBS) (including F orms & OAF pages) and modern web applications. • Target Environments: The DAP must be deployable and tested across both Development (Dev) and Test environments before transitioning to

The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The proposed acquisition strategy is currently under evaluation and being finalized by the Government. Sourcing options and potential contract vehicles are still being actively reviewed to ensure the final strategy maximizes efficiency while preserving competitive opportunities to the greatest extent practicable. The resulting contract structure is anticipated to be a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) vehicle consisting of a five-year lifecycle (one-year base period plus four one-year option periods).
